purpose: Reusable vocabularies for reviewer-comment triage (writing-07). Safe to edit: unknown keys are ignored by scripts/main.py.
cue_pattern: (should|must|please|need|recommend|suggest|add|clarify|explain|provide|report|cite|include|remove|rewrite|revise|expand|shorten|justify|specify|define|state|discuss|compare|show|consider|avoid|ensure|correct|quantif|separate|merge|check|confirm|align|follow|standardise|standardize)|建议|请|需要|应|必须|补充|增加|删|修改|澄清|说明|解释|明确|给出|提供|引用|标注|统一|核实|改写|简述|讨论|比较|避免|确保|纠正|量化|报告|列出|注明|区分
new_work_pattern: additional experiment|new experiment|re-?analy|re-?run|repeat the experiment|new data|extend the sample|new literature|补做|补充实验|重新分析|重做|新增实验|追加数据|补充文献
banned_claims: 已(?:补做|完成|新增)(?:实验|分析|测量|数据)
(?:the )?editor (?:has )?(?:accepted|decided to accept)|编辑部已(?:接收|录用|决定接收)
verbatim (?:quote|text) of the reviewer|审稿人原话|逐字引用审稿
(?:the )?entire manuscript (?:has been|was) (?:fully )?revised|整篇全文(?:返修|修改)完成
decision_rules: default accept when the change is executable inside the supplied baseline
partial when only part of the sub-requirement can be met inside the baseline (record what is missing)
clarify when the comment rests on a reading of the text that the baseline does not support but no contradiction exists
reject when the requested change would contradict supplied facts; keep the paragraph and explain
invalid when the comment contradicts the baseline (wrong section, wrong number, already addressed); never silently drop it

evidence_status.provided: the requested datum/reference already exists in the supplied materials and is cited by locator
evidence_status.not_provided: not available in the supplied materials; state why and never claim it was produced
evidence_status.not_applicable: the sub-requirement needs no new evidence

tone_levels.accept: agree, state the concrete change and its locator
tone_levels.clarify: restate what the baseline actually says, then the change
tone_levels.polite_rebuttal: acknowledge the concern, give the re-checked evidence, retain the text
tone_levels.appeal: point out the mismatch factually and offer to comply if the editor prefers otherwise
